name: Short Cakes
description: Historical recipe from Miss Leslie's Complete Cookery (1851). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: quarters of a pound of fresh butter
ingredients.originalText: three quarters of a pound of fresh butter

ingredients.name: and a half of sifted flour
ingredients.originalText: a pound and a half of sifted flour

instructions.text: Rub three quarters of a pound of fresh butter into a pound and a half of sifted flour
Make it into a dough with a little cold water
Roll it out into a sheet half an inch thick, and cut it into round cakes with the edge of a tumbler
Prick them with a fork; lay them in a shallow iron pan sprinkled with flour
Bake them in a moderate oven till they are brown
Send them to table hot; split and butter them

source.author: Eliza Leslie
source.originalInstructions:
1. Rub three quarters of a pound of fresh butter into a pound and a half of sifted flour
2. Make it into a dough with a little cold water
3. Roll it out into a sheet half an inch thick, and cut it into round cakes with the edge of a tumbler
4. Prick them with a fork; lay them in a shallow iron pan sprinkled with flour
5. Bake them in a moderate oven till they are brown
6. Send them to table hot; split and butter them
